title: Updating the sssd package in MLM 5.0.7 and 5.1.3 breaks AD | SUSE | Support Center
plain_text:
Updating the sssd package in MLM 5.0.7 and 5.1.3 breaks AD
Environment
Help Environment

SUSE Multi-Linux Manager (MLM) 5.1.3
SUSE Multi-Linux Manager (MLM) 5.0.7

Situation

MLM UI domain logins using Kerberos (via sssd-ad, sssd-krb, or sssd-ldap with SASL/GSSAPI/GSS-SPNEGO) have stopped working upon updating to MLM 5.0.7 or 5.1.3. The sssd service will not start.

Errors similar to

2026-04-24T19:02:09+0200 uyuni-server.mgr.internal ldap_child[120]: krb5_kt_start_seq_get failed: Key table file '/etc/rhn/krb5.conf.d/krb5.keytab' not found
2026-04-24T19:02:09+0200 uyuni-server.mgr.internal ldap_child[120]: Failed to read keytab [FILE:/etc/rhn/krb5.conf.d/krb5.keytab]: No suitable principal found in keytab

might be found in in the system event logs of the container.

Resolution

From the host, update the ownership of the SSSD and Kerberos files and directories. Change the owner and group to sssd.

mgrctl exec -- "chown -R sssd:sssd /etc/rhn/krb5.conf{,.d}/*; chown sssd:sssd /var/lib/sss"

Restart the SSSD service in uyuni-server container after applying the change.

mgrctl exec -- systemctl restart sssd
Cause

In the updated version of sssd, 2.10.0, there was a change in the way in which the sssd service was run. Changing from running as the privileged root user to the unprivileged sssd user.  This change was not accounted for when the SUSE Multi-Linux Manager container was updated to version 5.0.7 or 5.1.3.

Additional Information

Release notes for the SSSD version included in MLM 5.0.7 and 5.1.3 are available here: https://lists.suse.com/pipermail/sle-updates/2026-February/044304.html .

 

Note: In MLM >= 5.1.3.1, SSSD has reverted to running as the privileged root user. Therefore, the resolution in this article is obsolete. Ownership of Kerberos files in /etc/rhn/krb5.conf{,.d}/* must be changed back to root. For further details, see the article: 'MLM UI domain logins using Kerberos... have stopped working after updating from MLM 5.1.3'.
